name: iloader
use_label: Sideload apps onto your iPhone easily
one_liner: A desktop companion that makes it easy to sideload SideStore and other apps onto an iPhone.

text.why: Getting a tool like SideStore onto an iPhone, and preparing its pairing file, is the fiddly part. iloader turns it into a few buttons.
text.take: It puts the step where most people get stuck on one screen.
build: A desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Plug in the iPhone over USB, sign in with your Apple ID, then install SideStore (stable or nightly), LiveContainer + SideStore, or import an IPA, and manage pairing files, certificates and app IDs.

who.role: iPhone users who want to run apps that aren't on the App Store.

start.text: Set up usbmuxd (iTunes on Windows; included on macOS), install the app from GitHub Releases or iloader.app, plug in the iPhone and sign in with your Apple ID.

caveat: Requires signing in with an Apple ID. Per the README, the repository and iloader.app are the only official downloads; the Homebrew cask is unofficial.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
